facts.fact: AMI reports the National Assembly adopted on 30 January 2018 the 102-article bill on electronic transactions (electronic writing equal to paper, e-commerce provider liability, a national certification authority); the report does not say it was promulgated.
facts.system: Projet de loi portant sur les transactions électroniques

facts.fact: The minister told the Assembly that before this bill the law covered banking operations and some aspects of e-commerce under ordinance No. 2006-031 of 23 August 2006 on payment instruments and e-commerce operations, with implementing texts; AMI reports this on 2018-01-30.
facts.system: Ordonnance n° 2006-031 relative aux instruments de paiement et aux opérations du commerce électronique
